title: TTZipABBenchmarkContract
description: JSON Schema contract representing automated A/B benchmark telemetry and statistical delta gate result.

candidateCommit.description: Candidate git commit hash or working tree identifier.

sampleRounds.description: Number of interleaved benchmark measurement rounds.

e2eExtractSpeedupPercent.description: End-to-end extraction speedup percentage (positive indicates improvement).

quickLookSpeedupPercent.description: Single-entry Quick Look extraction speedup percentage.
